payload.instructions: A single assumption changes. Predict the impact.

questions.scenario: A fixed-income portfolio has a duration of 4 years.
questions.drift: The portfolio is rebalanced to increase duration to 7 years.
questions.prompt: If interest rates decrease slightly, what happens to the magnitude of the portfolio's price increase?

solution.text: Higher duration increases sensitivity to interest rate changes. When rates fall, longer-duration portfolios experience larger price increases.
